question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The __mellow__ tune of the flute soothes me.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Harsh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"mellow"** means something that is smooth, soft, or soothing, often used to describe sounds, flavors, or personalities. (मुलायम, सुहाना)
 
 
• **Example:** The mellow colors of the sunset made the evening feel magical.
 
 
• **"Harsh"** refers to something that is rough, unpleasant, or severe, often used to describe sounds or actions. (कठोर, तीखा)
 
 
• **Example:** The harsh sound of the alarm woke everyone abruptly.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'mellow'** is **'harsh'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Harsh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Quiet** (शांत): Free from noise or disturbance; calm and silent.
 
 
• **Example:** The library was so quiet that you could hear a pin drop.
 
 

 
• **Golden** (स्वर्णिम): Having a rich, yellow color or symbolizing something precious or highly valued.
 
 
• **Example:** The golden rays of the sun illuminated the room beautifully.
 
 

 
• **Lyrical** (गीतात्मक): Expressing emotions in a beautiful, poetic, or musical way.
 
 
• **Example:** The lyrical melody of the song transported listeners to another world.
